projectDescription: A browser-based endless runner game where you guide Santa Claus through a scrolling landscape, jumping over flame obstacles to achieve the highest score possible.
keyFeatures: Sprite-based Santa character with four animation states: Idle, Run, Jump, and Dead
Randomized flame obstacle spawning with variable gap distances (400–1000px)
Parallax scrolling background that moves in sync with gameplay speed
Real-time score counter that increments every 100ms while alive
Sound effects for running, jumping, and game-over events
Game Over screen with final score display and instant restart
Pixel-perfect collision detection between Santa and obstacles
Pure vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript — no build tools or dependencies required
publicApiSurface: keyCheck(event) — keyboard event handler (Enter to start, Space to jump)
run() — advances Run sprite animation frame (11 frames, loops)
idle() — advances Idle sprite animation frame (16 frames, loops)
jump() — advances Jump sprite animation and updates Santa's vertical position
dead() — advances Dead sprite animation and triggers Game Over screen
createBlock() — spawns a new flame obstacle at a randomized horizontal offset
moveBlocks() — translates all active obstacles left and checks collision
moveBackground() — scrolls the parallax background left by 20px per tick
updateScore() — increments and displays the current score
re() — reloads the page to restart the game
